experiment: C05 matched-seat promotion of the v6 candidate policy against shipped v5

amendment_justification.calibration_gates: v2 predates the player-calibration amendment; v3 incorporates the reviewer-frozen player-calibration gates (player-calibration-v1.json, byte-identical copy in this directory) as hard promotion preconditions.
amendment_justification.ci_method: v2 named thresholds but froze no CI construction; v3 freezes a deterministic seat-clustered paired bootstrap so two independent runs of the analysis are byte-identical.
amendment_justification.seed_derivation: v2 froze base seeds and the draft stream offset but not the per-slice evaluation seed; v3 freezes the exact derivation formula.
amendment_justification.limits_and_slices: v2 had no runtime/memory limits, no explicit mandatory high-risk slice list, no hidden-regression rule, and no n_seasons freeze; v3 adds all four.
amendment_justification.versioning_note: The C01 scope amendment reserves promotion-v3.json for the calibration additions; this file is that version, authored during C05 preparation. If the C02 session independently authors a promotion-v3, the later-integrated one is renumbered v4 at integration; versions are append-only and nothing here overwrites v1/v2.

hypotheses: The v6 candidate policy improves locked-lineup started points versus shipped v5 without deterministic, mandatory-slice, H2H, or playoff/championship regression.
The improvement survives held-out season confirmation and is not an artifact of the fit seasons.
Player-value calibration corrections do not degrade any mandatory cohort or format slice.

control.name: v5_shipped
control.policy_identity: engine + frontend policy code at baseline_sha 01f01d3c5f9c00a046edd43707db75ce1426c0e8, policy mix static_proxy/vorp_adp/engine_msv, shipped coefficients unmodified

candidate.name: v6_candidate
candidate.policy_identity: engine + frontend policy code at the frozen combined candidate SHA (C02, C03, C04 each independently PASSed and merged), same policy mix, no coefficients tuned after freeze
candidate.sha_freeze_rule: combined_candidate_sha MUST be recorded in a versioned execution addendum (promotion-v3-exec-v1.json) before the authoritative run; a null SHA makes any authoritative result invalid

pairing_rule: Both arms evaluate the identical (year, league_id, base_seed) slice with the identical board, identical seat-policy permutation, and identical eval seed. Pair key = (year, league_id, base_seed, seat). Seat-policy assignment: policies cycled over seats then shuffled by the seeded draft rng exactly as season_eval.draft_league; the permutation is a pure function of the eval seed and team count, hence identical in both arms (common random numbers). Any pairing-field mismatch aborts before analysis.
common_random_numbers: One eval seed drives draft seats (+303), injury paths (+101+s), availability draws (+202+s), and waiver order in both arms; arms may differ only in policy code.

board_corpus.definition: per (corpus_year, league_id): player pool = blitz_engine.simulation.season_eval.build_players(year, league_id) over fixtures/seasons/<year>.json; initial draft board = players sorted by (-projection, player_id); both arms draft from the identical board (CRN).

league_configurations.mandatory_league_ids: identical to the 216-id list frozen in promotion-v2.json (sha256 89ec1ce2e45591b06285ed384262a14a82937fd7b3076d5f2d6f290fbb126d01): the cartesian product teams {10,12,14} x qb_mode {1qb,superflex,2qb} x scoring {std,half,ppr} x te_premium {0.0,0.5} x bench {4,8} x ir {0,1}, ids as encoded in fixtures/league_matrix.json
league_configurations.scoring_configs: as encoded per row in fixtures/league_matrix.json (frozen by hash above)

held_out_rule: Held-out 2018 data may not be read during fitting, tuning, selection, or any pre-confirmation analysis. The runner's HeldOutGuard denies access unless the analysis stage is 'confirm', and every access is logged into the receipts. The confirm stage runs once, after the fit-season verdict, with no candidate modification afterwards.

evaluator.metric_definition: SeasonEvalResult.started_points: mean locked-lineup regular-season points per seat, averaged over n_seasons sampled trajectories

ci_method.name: seat-clustered paired percentile bootstrap
ci_method.unit: per-seat mean paired delta (per-season draws within a seat are averaged first; seats are the independent resampling unit)
ci_method.p_value: blitz_engine.backtest.ablation.paired_permutation_p on the seat-level deltas, reported alongside (not a gate)

mandatory_high_risk_slice_rationale: every 14-team, multi-QB, 4-bench configuration: the family containing the known v5 regression t14-2qb-std-te0.5-b4-ir1 (-25.3 pts/season, p=0.0025) plus the superflex QB-replacement risk surfaced by the player-value audit; smallest bench = least room to absorb a policy mistake
slice_gate: each mandatory high-risk slice passes no_regression semantics with tolerance 0.0: seat-level mean paired started-points delta >= 0.0 on fit seasons; identical rule on held-out confirmation
hidden_regression_rule: per-league-id paired deltas are reported for all 216 mandatory ids across all seasons; any id whose started-points CI95 upper bound < 0 (a significant regression anywhere) fails promotion regardless of the aggregate; aggregate averaging can never absolve a slice
mandatory_slice_reports: per mandatory high-risk slice (24 ids x fit seasons, and x held-out season at confirm)
per league id (all 216) aggregated over seasons
held-out season aggregate and held-out mandatory high-risk slices

calibration_gates.requirement: C05 promotion requires an executed C02 calibration report satisfying every player-calibration-v1 threshold: benchmark source identity and snapshots frozen (retrieval UTC, content hash, match report) before execution; deterministic_unit_failures = 0; unmatched_top_100_rate <= 0.02; spearman_rho delta >= 0.0; weighted_absolute_rank_error delta <= 0.0; top-12/24/50 recall reported with no material regression; positional median bias and all cohorts (rookie, veteran_age_30_plus, injury_designation, team_change, missing_adp, missing_depth, low_availability) reported with zero material regressions; largest per-player outliers and full component decomposition reported; missing-data rows degrade explicitly and are never imputed from search popularity; held-out confirmation per that manifest
calibration_gates.missing_report_interpretation: no executed calibration report, or a report failing any threshold, means the candidate is not promotable (numerical_fail), never inconclusive

promotion_requirements: all deterministic correctness and roster invariants pass
every mandatory high-risk slice passes no_regression(tolerance=0.0)
H2H win-rate CI95 lower bound >= -0.005 absolute
no known regression hidden by aggregate averaging (hidden_regression_rule)

limits.compute: single local machine, free compute only, no cloud or paid data
limits.receipt_rule: runtime and peak RSS are recorded per arm run and for the whole experiment; exceeding a limit fails promotion (numerical_fail) and requires a new manifest version to change a limit

failure_interpretation.pairing_mismatch: BLOCK (seats/seeds/boards must match before any analysis)
failure_interpretation.zero_evidence: an all-zero or empty paired-delta primary sample is inconclusive, never a pass
failure_interpretation.dry_run: any run against synthetic data or unchanged/baseline policies is non-authoritative and can justify nothing

execution_preconditions: C02, C03, C04 each independently PASSed
combined candidate SHA frozen in promotion-v3-exec-v1.json
C02 calibration report executed and archived with input hashes
playoff/championship proxy metrics present in SeasonEvalResult (C02 deliverable)
